heading: Family-run, Las Cruces proud
body:
3 Brothers Shop started at the Las Cruces Farmers & Crafts Market, selling rustic furniture, Mexican imports and Día de los Muertos merchandise from a booth on Main Street. In October 2026, owner Javier Macias opened the shop's first permanent location at 130 S Main St, right in the heart of downtown.

Every piece is picked by hand: pottery and figurines painted by Mexican artisans, longhorns and western décor, and rustic wood furniture with real character. Stop by, say hello, and find something that makes your home feel like the Southwest.
